# Frozen environment for the OpenTimestamps integrity workflows.
#
# NOT a minimum-version range. `opentimestamps>=0.4.5` was insufficient: an
# integrity job must behave identically on every run, and a floating dependency
# is how proof handling silently changes between runs.
#
# Runner : ubuntu-24.04 (pinned; not ubuntu-latest)
# Python : 3.11.9      (pinned; the CLI cannot import on 3.12 --
#                       python-bitcoinlib raises TypeError there)
opentimestamps==0.4.5
opentimestamps-client==0.7.1
python-bitcoinlib==0.11.0
pysocks==1.7.1
